evals.prompt: I'm shipping a universal iPhone + iPad app and need to prep the App Store screenshots. I'm automating with fastlane. What sizes do I actually have to produce, and roughly how should I set it up?
evals.expected_output: Identifies 6.9" iPhone and 13" iPad as the two canonical sizes to produce, explains App Store Connect auto-scales the smaller classes, gives correct dimensions, and points to fastlane snapshot/frameit/deliver. States the 1-10 count and PNG/JPEG formats.
expectations: Identifies 6.9" (iPhone) and 13" (iPad) as the two canonical sizes to produce
Gives a correct 6.9" iPhone size (1290x2796, 1320x2868, or 1260x2736) and a correct 13" iPad size (2064x2752 or 2048x2732)
States App Store Connect auto-scales the smaller device classes from the largest uploaded set, so you don't produce every size
Recommends fastlane snapshot for capture (ideally also frameit and/or deliver)
States the 1-10 screenshots-per-class limit and PNG/JPEG formats

evals.prompt: App Store Connect just rejected my screenshot upload — it says the dimensions are wrong for my iPhone 16 Pro Max screenshots. What size are they supposed to be?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the iPhone 16 Pro Max as the 6.9" display class and gives the correct accepted sizes (1290x2796 standard, also 1320x2868 / 1260x2736). Does not claim 1290x2796 would be rejected. Notes formats and that the 6.9" set covers smaller classes via auto-scaling.
expectations: Identifies the iPhone 16 Pro Max as the 6.9" display class
States 1290x2796 is an accepted size for the 16 Pro Max and does NOT claim it would be rejected
Mentions the alternate accepted 6.9" sizes (1320x2868 and/or 1260x2736)
Notes the 6.9" set auto-covers smaller iPhone classes, and/or states PNG/JPEG and the 1-10 count

evals.prompt: Help me plan and create the screenshots for my new App Store listing. It's a habit-tracking iOS app, going out in English, Spanish, and Japanese.
evals.expected_output: Covers the full workflow: 6.9" iPhone canonical size with auto-scaling, capturing a 3-locale set with fastlane snapshot, design/ordering guidance, and localization. Stays at the right altitude without dumping every device dimension.
expectations: Identifies 6.9" iPhone as the canonical size to produce, with auto-scaling to smaller classes
Addresses localization across the three languages (per-locale screenshot sets and/or localized captions)
Recommends automation suited to a multi-locale set (fastlane snapshot across the language matrix)
Includes screenshot design/ordering guidance (first 2-3 strongest, one idea per shot, legible captions)
Stays at the right altitude — does not paste the full per-device dimension table into the answer

evals.prompt: Can I add a preview video to my Mac app's App Store page? What are the constraints — length, format, that kind of thing?
evals.expected_output: Confirms app previews are supported, up to 3 per class, 15-30s, <=500 MB, H.264 or ProRes 422 (HQ), macOS landscape-only at 1920x1080, autoplay muted.
expectations: Confirms Mac apps support app previews
States the length is 15-30 seconds
States the maximum file size is 500 MB
States the format is H.264 or ProRes 422 (HQ)
States macOS previews are landscape-only at 1920x1080, and does NOT list 2560x1600 or 2880x1800 as preview sizes
Notes previews autoplay muted / advises designing for sound-off
